items.title: The Unaffordable Dream: Why National And Social Health Insurance Cannot Work In Malaysia
items.summary: Malaysia already has a tax-funded public health care system that, for all its flaws, provides affordable care to the vast majority. The answer is not to abandon this system for an untested, unaffordable, and politically untenable NHI or SHI scheme.
